result.analyst_notes: Confident, first-person plural voice with absolute, unhedged claims. Opens by centring knowledge, innovation and teamwork rather than stakeholders. Customer performance is framed as the purpose of those assets. Innovation receives the strongest emphasis, with R&E investment cited as evidence. Language is aspirational with factual scale details, and no safety, environmental or governance commitments appear.
